description: This file defines the GameState class which models the current state of a Wordle-like game. It includes properties for the target word, guesses, attempt number, input state, game completion status, keyboard state, and timestamps. It also provides methods for copying, serialization, and deserialization of game state data.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Represents the current state of a Wordle game session, encapsulating guesses, attempt count, game status, keyboard state, and timestamps.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current GameState with optional property overrides.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the GameState to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON map into a GameState instance.
